messages:
Jen (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: this thread is for clarifying hiring, org maps, and transition questions. We'll answer live and pin the outcomes.
Leah (People Ops): Short version: no layoffs. We're shifting hiring toward infra, security, and compliance to support Dedicated & Private launches. Some non-critical product roles will be delayed.
Marcus (Head of Eng): To add detail: SRE, infra, and runtime teams get front-loaded headcount for the next two quarters. That helps latency and SLA targets.
Nina (EM): If my team's req is deprioritized, will we be required to rotate engineers to infra?
Leah (People Ops): Not forced. Options: internal redeploy, temporary cross-team support, or a paused backfill. We'll work with managers to find the least disruptive path. Expect outreach within 72 hours.
Diego (SWE): What's the timeline for the org map update? We need reporting lines for Q3 planning.
Jen (CEO): Draft org maps will go live by next Monday as "draft". We'll collect feedback for one week before finalizing.
Ravi (VP Product): Customer-facing commitments (Dedicated deployments & SLA-linked projects) are insulated. Roles tied directly to customer SLAs stay prioritized.
PeopleOpsBot: New doc: https://go.redwood/people-update (Headcount buckets + redeploy guidance).
Leah (People Ops): We'll post a spreadsheet with functions, flagged roles, and a short rationale column. Office hours Thursday 11am PT to walk through it.
Nina (EM): Are promotion cycles or manager hires changing?
Marcus (Head of Eng): Promotion cycles unchanged. We're pausing most new manager hires unless they directly increase team scalability or reliability.
Diego (SWE): Any impact on contractor conversions?
Leah (People Ops): Contractors evaluated case-by-case. We'll prioritize converting critical infra contractors to full-time where it reduces ramp time.
Nina (EM): If I want to keep a paused req open, who do I talk to?
Marcus (Head of Eng): DM me + Leah with a one-paragraph case and a success metric. We'll triage exceptions.
Leah (People Ops): Reminder: internal mobility first. Teams should post backfills to the internal job board for 3 business days before external posting (exceptions for urgent infra roles).
Jen (CEO): High level: prioritization to keep the business healthy and fund key launches. We'll be transparent, offer redeploy options, and support impacted folks.
Diego (SWE): Thanks. Appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:
Leah (People Ops): Office hours link in the doc. If you can't make it, drop questions here or email people-ops and we'll follow up.
Jen (CEO): We'll update the all-hands slides with the adjusted hiring forecast and archive the previous version. Reactions are fine for quick ack so replies stay concise. :sparkles:
